mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS declines m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and industrial production (also INDPRO) is rising month-over-month, it signals a strengthening manufacturing sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and rising m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is rising month-over-month, it signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL rising m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
